prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one-image Meshy 7 3D model input reference for a Hearts of Iron IV WWII-horror civilian zombie
Primary request: create one substantially original, model-ready full-body reference image of a single unarmed civilian zombie. This is a source-free original design explicitly authorized by the user for this base zombie; do not use or imitate any existing zombie art, historical photo, model, screenshot, or other reference.
Subject: one adult human civilian zombie, with an ordinary mixed civilian appearance rather than a uniformed soldier. Pale desaturated gray-green skin, tired sunken eyes, slack but readable expression, and only restrained non-graphic signs of decay. Wear simple, worn 1936–1945 civilian clothes in muted gray, olive, and brown: a plain aged button-front shirt, practical trousers, and modest worn civilian shoes. No uniform, insignia, badge, armband, pack, tools, weapons, jewelry, or other props. Show clear clothing seams and distinct skin, cloth, and shoe materials.
Style/medium: grounded, non-anime HOI4/WWII horror character concept with believable human anatomy and restrained realistic surface detail; useful as a clean 3D reconstruction reference, not cinematic scene art.
Composition/framing: exactly one figure, straight-on front view, full head-to-shoe silhouette centered on a vertical portrait canvas with comfortable clear margin; camera at body mid-height with little perspective distortion. Relaxed rig-friendly A-pose: both arms held outward and slightly down from the shoulders, elbows only gently bent, hands open and empty with separated readable fingers; legs straight with a small gap between them, both feet fully visible and planted. Keep arms, hands, legs, shoes, and torso clearly separated in silhouette. No cropped body parts, overlap that hides anatomy, or dynamic action pose.
Lighting/mood: even neutral soft studio lighting, enough to read form and material without dramatic shadows.
Color palette: pale gray-green skin; subdued gray, olive, and brown civilian fabric; low-saturation natural colors.
Scene/backdrop: request a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, including transparent unused canvas. No floor, environment, smoke, cast shadow, glow, or background illustration.
Constraints: model-ready full-body anatomy and clothing coverage; non-anime proportions; 1936–1945 civilian period fit; visible empty hands and both feet.
Avoid: any weapon or prop, extra figures, military uniform, modern clothing or gear, gore, exposed bones, dismemberment, exaggerated fantasy features, anime/manga/chibi style, text, watermark, frame, border, collage, turnaround, side view, or multiple views.
